bootstrap(address[]).details: Can only be called once by deployer. After this:      - All adapters are registered and enabled      - BOOTSTRAP_ROLE is renounced (no one has it)      - This function reverts on any subsequent call

params.adapters: Array of adapter addresses to register and enable

returns._0: True if bootstrapper can still call addAdapter

initialize(address,address).details: deployer_ is explicit — msg.sender in initialize() would be AdapterFactory, not deployer.

bootstrap(address[]).notice: Register all adapters and renounce BOOTSTRAP_ROLE

deployer().notice: The deployer who can execute bootstrap

hasBootstrapRole().notice: Check if this bootstrapper still has BOOTSTRAP_ROLE

initialize(address,address).notice: One-shot initialization called atomically by AdapterFactory.

isBootstrapped().notice: Check if bootstrap has been executed

strategy().notice: The strategy this bootstrapper is bound to
